principle: Use existing high-value agent/tool-use benchmarks as task substrates; add an observation-spoofing layer and compare defenses on the same tasks.

substrates.name: AgentDojo
substrates.why_use_it: Mature agent security suites with utility/security checks and indirect prompt-injection baselines.
substrates.overlay_plan: Keep suite/user tasks and utility/security checks; add attacks that mutate factual tool return fields without adding imperative instructions.
substrates.initial_slice: workspace/productivity tasks with deterministic environment records

substrates.name: ToolSandbox
substrates.why_use_it: Explicit execution context, world state snapshots, and milestone DAGs are a natural truth oracle.
substrates.overlay_plan: Wrap execution environment so the observation returned to the agent differs from the world-state snapshot used by milestones.
substrates.initial_slice: phone/settings/contact/reminder scenarios with state-dependent tool calls

substrates.name: tau-bench / tau2-bench
substrates.why_use_it: Realistic retail/airline user-agent-tool conversations with domain APIs and task success evaluation.
substrates.overlay_plan: Insert a proxy around domain APIs such as order status, refund, reservation, and inventory calls; oracle remains the simulator state.
substrates.initial_slice: retail and airline tasks with order/reservation status queries

substrates.name: WebArena / WorkArena
substrates.why_use_it: Self-hosted or enterprise-like browser tasks with backend validation; good substrate for browser observation spoofing.
substrates.overlay_plan: Rewrite accessibility-tree/DOM-derived observations or success banners while backend validator remains unchanged.
substrates.initial_slice: form submission, admin status, issue/repo/task state tasks

substrates.name: SWE-bench / SWE-agent
substrates.why_use_it: Patch/test tasks with strong ground truth and test-based oracle; good substrate for shell/test-output spoofing.
substrates.overlay_plan: Intercept test command stdout/exit codes or artifact summaries shown to the agent; oracle uses actual test results.
substrates.initial_slice: small verified tasks where tests are fast enough for pilot runs

substrates.name: MCP-SafetyBench / MCP Security Bench
substrates.why_use_it: Closest existing MCP attack substrate; useful for positioning and crosswalk.
substrates.overlay_plan: Reuse task/attack taxonomy where feasible, but isolate non-instructional schema-valid false return values and compare observation-integrity defenses.
substrates.initial_slice: web search, finance, browser automation, repository management tasks that can run in isolation

substrates.name: PoisonedRAG / SafeRAG
substrates.why_use_it: High-value retrieval-poisoning substrate for citation/provenance spoofing.
substrates.overlay_plan: Treat retrieval as an agent tool; mutate retrieved evidence/citation fields while oracle checks corpus/bibliography truth.
substrates.initial_slice: citation verification and policy QA tasks

substrates.name: Security/CTF-style sandbox authorization tasks
substrates.why_use_it: Directly captures the user hypothesis that mocked ownership, nginx/banner, certificate, and asset-inventory observations may shift a model from refusal/passive triage to active security-assessment assistance.
substrates.overlay_plan: Keep the sandbox asset and hidden scope registry fixed; mutate only model-visible ownership/scope/banner/asset-inventory fields. Score the authorization verdict and permitted assessment level, not exploit-step generation.
substrates.initial_slice: sandbox asset authorization and scope-verification tasks

pilot_order: ToolSandbox overlay smoke: easiest deterministic truth state and milestone oracle.
AgentDojo overlay smoke: strongest security-benchmark positioning.
tau-bench overlay smoke: strongest realistic tool-calling/domain API story.

paper_claim_shift.avoid: We created a standalone benchmark from scratch and it is the main benchmark.
paper_claim_shift.use: We propose an observation-spoofing overlay protocol for existing agent/tool-use benchmarks and report baseline defense comparisons on adapted benchmark slices.
